description: Standalone patch-guide record. RESERVED: the JAH-PATCH-%07d ID scheme is reserved in music-manifest.json but no patch IDs have been issued as of 2026-10-03. Today every equipment record (JAH-GEAR-######) carries its patch guide inline in the 'patch' field (equipment.schema.json); this schema defines the intended standalone shape when patch IDs are issued. See RECORD-STANDARD.md 'real patch guides' for the guide_class honesty vocabulary.

equipment_id.description: The equipment this guide is written for. Pattern of JAH-GEAR-###### IDs.

equipment_name.description: Equipment display name, e.g. 'Signature Stage Electric Guitar Mk 3'.

guide_class.description: Honesty classification of the guide. Archive guides (generated routing text for Signature-original equipment) are 'documented'. See RECORD-STANDARD.md.

note.description: Honesty note, e.g. which equipment revision the guide was written against.

patch.description: The patch guide text, same form as the equipment 'patch' field: routing chain plus gain note, e.g. 'Patch guide: <name> -> Patch-16 top row -> PA-1 preamp -> IO-8 input 3. Set gain so peaks hit -12 dB.'

title: Signature Music Studio — Patch-guide record (reserved)
